title: mac-slot tests assert wall-clock bounds that a busy Mac can break: a false failure when other jobs load it
evidence: Found 2026-11-13 in the mac-slot test isolation survey (its item 4). tools/mac-slot.test.ts bounds: a status probe's lock retried within 0.05 s, the slot freed within 5 s of a SIGKILL, TERM exiting within 3 s and within 1 s (slot wait), INT within 1 s, under 0.3 s of CPU in a 3 s wait, a freed slot taken within 1 s, a stale marker cleared within 2 s (two tests), and a marker present 0.3 s after start. None failed in five runs on 2026-11-13; loosen one only when it fails, and keep the bound the pin needs
